messages.author: Matthew Guberman-Pfeffer
messages.body:
Dear AMBER Community,
Is there a way to print out with CPPTRAJ the x, y, and z components of the minimum displacement between two groups?
I know that the mindist option to nativecontacts will give the minimum distance, but I need the x, y, and z components used to compute that distance. If I need to add a print statement to the source code, can you please direct me to where I should do that?
Best,
Matthew

messages.author: Daniel Roe
messages.body:
Hi,
I think 'vector minimage' should do what you want. See the manual for
full details.
-Dan

messages.author: Steinbrecher, Thomas
messages.body:
Hi Matthew,
could the vector or multivector commands in cpptraj do that for you? There
is no minimum distance option afaik, but depending on how big your groups
are, you could get all vectors and then look at the xyz components of the
one with minimum length.
Kind Regards,
Thomas
